0022600143.text: The LA Clippers, 1-2 on the season and 1-0 at home, host the Los Angeles Lakers, who are 3-0 and riding a three-game winning streak, after the Clippers dropped their last two games. The Clippers are 3rd in the Pacific, 2 games back, and 9th in the West, while the Lakers lead the Pacific and sit 3rd in the West. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), Rui Hachimura (quadriceps soreness), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), and the Lakers are without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain). The Clippers trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 125-117 in Los Angeles on October 23, 2026, and the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2.
